description: She will now face Republican Kevin Hern, a U.S. representative from Oklahoma's 1st District since 2018 and a candidate endorsed by President Donald Trump, in a race where she starts at a clear disadvantage, as Oklahoma has not elected a Democrat to the Senate since 1990.

title: VOz: “Who is N'Kiyla Jasmine Thomas, the socialist nurse who caused an upset in Oklahoma and pledged to remove Trump from office if she reaches the Senate” — Jasmine Thomas for Oklahoma
